title: PBA: Triple-double for Juan Gomez de Liaño as Converge dismantles Macau
summary: Juan Gómez de Liaño tallied a triple-double as Converge dismantled Macau, 162-108, in the PBA Season 50 Governors' Cup on Friday at the Ynares Center in Antipolo.
